newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV top Vienna gainer on H1 earnings rise.
newsitem.headline: OMV top Vienna gainer on H1 earnings rise.

text.p: Shares in oil and chemicals group OMV AG rallied in a buoyant Vienna market on Tuesday after reporting a 100 percent rise in half-year earnings and saying more heady gains could be expected for the full year.
By 0935 GMT, OMV was the top gainer in Vienna, standing 6.18 percent higher at 1,757 schillings while the blue-chip ATX index stood 2.37 percent higher.
For the six months OMV said earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) surged to 3.11 billion schillings from 1.52 billion in the year-ago period.
"They are very good results. The company looks like it's benefiting from more than just the commodity environment," said an analyst at a brokerage in London.
Chief executive Richard Schenz told journalists he expects EBIT for the full year to rise to just under five billion schillings after 2.92 billion last year. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
